execution.operator_algorithm: the governed CLI manifest algorithm enum data_parallel names this exact numerical algorithm; other operator algorithm values are rejected
execution.rank_assignment: each barrier assigns consecutive registered documents to ranks in ascending order; each active rank executes exactly one clipped SGD document update from the same pinned weights; excess tail ranks acknowledge idle membership
execution.aggregation: float64 parameter arithmetic mean of active-rank updated parameters, reduced in ascending rank order; idle ranks do not dilute the mean
execution.equivalence: exact weights across uninterrupted and resumed executions of the same synchronous averaging algorithm; sequential per-document SGD is a different algorithm
execution.randomness: manifest seed initializes parameters once; no stochastic gradient draws or document shuffling
execution.transport: bounded local multiprocessing Pipe messages; no sockets, remote worker address, credentials, new service or runtime root

persistence.commit_boundary: all rank receipts for one complete barrier, full averaged weights, optimizer configuration, next epoch/document cursor and cumulative usage in one existing worker-fenced checkpoint transaction
persistence.history: each committed checkpoint contains the complete current barrier and all rank receipts; prior snapshots remain under the same SQLite owner until existing governed checkpoint archive retention verifies their exact CAS backups before pruning
persistence.rollback: an uncommitted failed barrier changes no persisted weights or cursor; disabling this optional trainer retains existing reference and single-worker neural paths

resume_payload.step_semantics: actual cumulative UTF-8 byte plus EOS training targets across all active ranks, counted once per document update; one barrier is one averaged optimizer update
resume_payload.budgets: existing neural max_steps/max_tokens/max_documents/max_updates/max_training_bytes/max_epochs/max_corpus_bytes remain cumulative; max_barriers bounds completed averaging barriers; max_processes bounds fixed local rank membership

recovery: require exact dataset rights, current quality and materialized corpus identity before spawning workers
persist full initial weights and cursor zero before the first barrier; recover exactly bound empty startup windows using existing worker epoch fencing
restore the authoritative checkpoint returned after worker recovery fencing before spawning replacement ranks
all rank acknowledgements must match current worker epoch, barrier, pinned weights, assigned document and target count before aggregation
assert current worker and dataset authority before dispatch and serialize durable checkpoint/completion commits against dataset revocation
a crash or failed rank after previous barriers resumes at the first uncommitted barrier; terminal reload does not spawn workers or perform SGD
failures: rank process exit, timeout, malformed receipt, parameter identity mismatch or duplicate rank/PID fails the entire uncommitted barrier
all rank processes and Pipe descriptors are stopped and joined on normal completion or any exception
stale parent worker cannot checkpoint, emit telemetry or terminalize replacement work
conflicting corpus/configuration/process count/budget rejects before worker allocation
payload and receipt tamper fails resume and completed artifact reload
revocation or quality failure denies continuation and artifact admission
scope_limitations: no remote cluster, elastic ranks, GPU collectives or neural quality claim
